title: External Technician · BBS field operations
subtitle: Authorized own work, expenses, reports, corrections and supplier operational evidence

chapters.title: Start with authorized supplier access
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: Use the individual External Technician account created or invited by the Owner. There is no public sign-up. Account activity, supplier association, supplier project authorization and your project assignment must all cover the work date. A supplier coordinator is a different role and may record team work; that does not let you see another technician’s sources.

This course uses BBS ROLE LAB External Technician in the isolated C-0050-P-20261005 · BBS · Ejemplo de manual project. New work is fictional, outside the original billed October 2–5 history. The supplier authorization covers October 5–31. No live dispatch, purchase, equipment change or bank transfer occurred.

Before practising obtain an operator-provided training URL, own account, visible environment identifier, permitted scope and reset instructions. No shared training credentials are supplied. Live company portal or webmail links open live services, never this isolated demonstration.
steps: Sign in with your own account and verify environment, account and language.
Use Time for your own hours, Expenses for your own operational purchases, Reports for your own Daily/Technical facts and Operational report for your allowed activity summary.
Use Profile and Help for own workforce/security settings and guidance.
checks: Your assigned BBS project is available. Finance, Billing, My Pay and supplier team administration are outside this role.
recovery: Ask the Owner/coordinator to investigate account, supplier authorization or assignment dates when the intended project is absent. Do not borrow an account or create duplicate work.

chapters.title: Save your own actual time and submit it
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: Actual hours describe work performed, independently of supplier plans or invoices. The exercise saved one hour on October 7 for fictional documentation work. Decimal 0.75 hour means 45 minutes; it is not 75 minutes.
Operational category describes activity. Choosing Overtime does not set a premium. Start/end times and meal expense are optional separate inputs; do not invent clock times from a duration.
steps: Choose Log time. Select Assigned project and Date, then Operational category, Actual hours and Activity summary.
Use Save draft. Open the saved source and verify account, project, date, duration and activity.
Use individual Submit and confirm Submitted. Saving alone is not submission or approval.
checks: One native one-hour own source was saved and submitted. It retained its own ID and history.
recovery: If Save seems uncertain, reload the filtered register and locate the existing row before trying again. Edit an unsent ordinary draft only through the current permitted controls.

figures.caption: Actual filled own time form before Save draft: one-hour fictional October 7 exercise.
Same own source Submitted to its permitted operational reviewer.

chapters.title: Correct returned time through a linked replacement
chapters.route: Time → Needs changes source → Create corrected draft
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: The Owner returned the one-hour source because actual duration was 0.75 hour. The technician created a linked correction rather than another unrelated time row. The original one-hour Needs changes record remains preserved.

Review every value before creating a correction: linked correction drafts do not offer unrestricted editing after creation. An unsubmitted Withdraw correction draft control requires a reason; withdrawal was inspected, not exercised.
steps: Open the original source and read the reviewer’s reason. Use Create corrected draft.
Review project/date/category/activity, enter Actual hours 0.75 and a concrete Correction reason; create the draft.
Open the linked Draft, inspect its original link and use individual Submit.
After reviewer approval inspect the current operational report/register rather than adding the old and replacement hours.
checks: Own corrected 45 minute source is Approved; original 60 minute source remains Needs changes. With coordinator-recorded 2 hours, current activity totals 165 minutes=2.75 hours.
recovery: A settled, invoiced or otherwise locked source may require Finance/Owner adjustment. Send the original ID and intended factual change; never shift dates or create duplicate work to evade a guard.

Linked 0.75-hour Draft retains the original source.

chapters.title: Review weekly tools without copying fictitious work
chapters.route: Time → Enter a week in a table; Submit this week
chapters.context: Reference procedure · current own-role controls/source checked; mutations not exercised
paragraphs: Weekly tools save your own daily drafts for actual work. Blank days are skipped. Review existing entries first to avoid duplicates. A copied previous-week layout carries zero hours and does not create evidence that work happened again.

Copy previous week layout: choose the destination Week of, inspect displayed Previous week / This week, then Add this week’s layout. These are displayed periods, not editable Source/Destination fields. Weekly draft submission can include eligible linked corrections; this course used individual correction Submit to inspect the original link.
steps: For a genuine workweek open Enter a week in a table, select Week of/project and fill worked days, then Save daily drafts.
Review saved records. Under Submit this week inspect the own-week draft count before Submit all week drafts.
For a linked correction use individual detail Submit when you need to inspect its history carefully.
checks: Draft, Submitted and Approved remain distinct. A zero-hour copied layout still needs genuine actual work.
recovery: Resolve the exact blocked/changed record. Do not keep submitting the entire week to force a guarded correction.

chapters.title: Record an own purchase with its private receipt
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: The worked expense is explicitly synthetic USD 8 tools/consumables on October 7, Worker payer. The receipt states no real purchase or payment. Your purchase facts are visible to you; Finance classification, customer recovery and reimbursement are later distinct decisions.
The actual form accepts JPG/PNG/HEIC/PDF receipt evidence up to 10 MB. Preserve the original currency and payer. A registered upload is not a universal assertion that an antivirus scan completed.
steps: Choose Record expense. Attach Receipt image or PDF; select Project, Date and Category. Enter Vendor, Amount 8, Currency USD, Who paid Worker and factual Description; fill applicable time/related-hours/payment context.
Use Save draft and open the saved expense. Check the registered receipt and purchase fields.
Use Submit. Genuine PM operationally approved this expense. Open private receipt now succeeds through your own authorized account.
checks: One USD 8 expense and one receipt exist. No Finance review, reimbursement payment or client invoice is claimed for this External exercise.
recovery: If receipt access or scan processing fails, report the document/expense ID and exact status. Do not create another expense while checking the first. Reviewed expense corrections follow the current permitted correction/handoff process.

chapters.title: Write and submit your own daily field report
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: Daily reports record operational facts, not timesheet hours, supplier payment or customer acceptance. This report’s author is the genuine External Technician account. Its fictional summary says no live equipment.

Fields include Project, Work date, Site / shift, Shift summary, Tasks completed, Problems found, Corrective actions, Downtime minutes, Standby reason, Open items, Next day plan and safety impact. Include genuine problems and next steps; do not invent a successful outcome.
steps: Choose New daily report and fill the actual work date/project and factual summary/tasks. Fill relevant operational exceptions and next steps.
Use Save daily report. Open the Draft and inspect saved contents. Autosaving or saving edits does not submit.
Use Submit for review. Confirm Submitted and the permitted reviewer’s later state.
checks: Own Daily progressed Draft→Submitted→Approved through genuine PM review. It did not add hours or record a customer signature.
recovery: Edit only through offered unsent-draft controls. For returned/approved content, preserve history and use a supported correction or reviewer handoff.

figures.caption: Native own Daily input in the role lab.
Own Daily after separate submission and genuine PM operational approval; ready output is a later step.

chapters.title: Document technical facts and validation
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: The exercised system is a fictional bench. No PLC program changed and no live validation is claimed. A technical report is evidence, not authorization to modify equipment or substitute for safety/change-control requirements.

Identify System / machine and applicable Plant / site, Area / line, Station / machine, System type, PLC platform, Controller, HMI / SCADA, Network / protocol, Software version and Program / project reference. Record Problem / symptom, Diagnosis / root cause, Change performed, production impact, validation/result, open risk and rollback.
steps: Choose New technical report. Select Project and Work date, identify equipment and enter readable factual diagnosis/change/validation/risk fields.
Use Save PLC report. Open the Draft and inspect the source.
Use Submit for review and inspect the permitted reviewer’s later state.
checks: Own Technical source saved, submitted and genuinely PM Approved. Native readable preview access was rechecked after a route-admission fix.
recovery: A real unresolved hazard/validation need belongs with the responsible technical lead/PM. Do not fabricate clean validation to complete a form.

figures.caption: Actual technical input for the clearly fictional external bench.
Own Technical operationally Approved; rebuilt native readable preview works.

chapters.title: Generate a ready own report PDF and preserve version meaning
chapters.route: Reports → own report detail → Generate report
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: The own Daily was approved before this output example. Choose the report language and Generate report; generation is asynchronous. Queued is not a downloaded file. Refresh/check its state and use Download only when Ready.

Initial testing discovered that the role route list blocked own previews and receipts even though their own record pages offered links. A bounded route fix retained existing session and exact object-scope checks. Rebuilt runtime checks confirmed own Daily/Technical previews and own receipt 200 while unrelated report/receipt 404 and financial routes 403 remained protected. The earlier 403 evidence is preserved as history, not the final operating result.

Private report evidence can be uploaded through Evidence type, File and Notes using the permitted draft controls. Offered types/limits are displayed; this role exercise did not upload report attachments. A Daily/Technical PDF is separate from reviewed customer period acceptance or supplier billing.
steps: On the own approved Daily choose English and Generate report. Wait for Queued processing.
Refresh until Ready and use Download / Download English. Open the native PDF and verify author/project/date/content.
Before report submission, use permitted private evidence controls for authorized attachments; never include unrelated people’s financial/private records.
checks: Native English Daily reached Ready and the own download succeeded. Own preview and receipt access works; unrelated source evidence remains inaccessible.
recovery: If Queued never completes, ask support to inspect the artifact using report ID/language/status. If preview/receipt denied, report exact URL/status; never use another account or fabricate a screenshot.

figures.caption: Actual rebuilt role view: own Approved Daily, ready English PDF and working preview.

chapters.title: Reconcile and download your own operational activity
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: This report contains operational work and approval status only. It does not certify supplier payment, compensation or customer acceptance. The technician sees its own coordinator-recorded work and its own corrected work, with Recorded by identifying the actor.

For October 6–31, current activity is 2 hrecorded by the supplier coordinator plus 0.75 hrecorded/corrected by the technician, total 2.75 h. The superseded 1 h source is not counted again. The CSV’s nine columns describe project, technician, date, category, actual hours/minutes, activity, state and recorder; it contains no pay/rates.
steps: Select Installation / project, From, To and Language; use Apply filters. Check the displayed date range and person before interpreting totals.
Inspect each current source’s duration, state and Recorded by.
Use Download CSV and open the native output. Print / save PDF uses the browser’s print flow; no separately generated operational PDF was saved in this lab.
checks: Own operational CSV downloaded successfully: two rows, 120+45 minutes=165 minutes, 2.75 h, only this technician.
recovery: If empty, check filters and authorization dates before assuming work is missing. Reconcile source states/corrections; do not add rows to match a planned total.

figures.caption: Native filtered own activity: coordinator 2 h plus own approved 0.75 h.

chapters.title: Use narrow screens and check saved results
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: Use role navigation and narrow-screen menu controls. Review account/project/date/member fields carefully before saving. A table’s internal horizontal-scroll hint is different from page-level overflow.
steps: On a phone open the required workspace through navigation and apply the intended scope.
After saving or submitting, reopen the existing source to verify its result rather than repeating the action.
checks: Operational report checked at 390 and 768 pixels: page width of the scrollable page matches viewport width; native two-source report retained. Desktop 1440 was also inspected.
recovery: Report clipped controls with a safe screenshot, width, environment and exact action. Never save duplicate records to compensate for a hidden result.

chapters.title: Maintain your workforce profile and individual security
chapters.route: Profile → Expertise and availability; Account security
chapters.context: Reference procedure · current own-role controls/source checked; mutations not exercised
paragraphs: Expertise and availability are planning inputs, distinct from supplier authorization/project assignment. The own profile was inspected natively; no security or profile mutations occurred here. A generic workforce-profile Worker label does not grant internal Worker financial workspaces.

Add expertise offers expertise/proficiency. Add availability opens dated UTC availability windows. Passkey registration uses Device name and Register passkey. Authenticator setup/recovery material is sensitive; never include it in report evidence.
steps: Check your own expertise and UTC calendar. Use offered own-profile controls only for genuine information.
For an authorized account-security change use your own device/authenticator prompts and verify completion before signing out. Store recovery codes in an approved password manager.
checks: Skills/availability do not grant review, supplier administration, private-pay or billing rights. Security success is not claimed from read-only controls.
recovery: Ask the Owner/coordinator for authorization/assignment changes and Owner/support for access recovery. Do not share credentials.

figures.caption: Own workforce profile inspected without generating any security secret.

chapters.title: Use Help and hand problems to the correct role
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: Help’s invitation lesson distinguishes mailbox-linked access and a single-use external invitation; there is no public signup. Supplier operations guidance has different paths for technician/coordinator.

The verified support contact is admin@j-aautomation.com. Live company portal/webmail links are live services. No email was sent in this exercise. External Technician has no My Pay workspace: supplier commercial/payment questions belong to the coordinator/Finance using their authorized process.
steps: Read the External technician starting path and normal-day guidance in Help.
Send actual source errors to the operational reviewer; supplier authorization/account questions to Owner/coordinator; financial issues to coordinator/Finance.
Include environment, role, project/record ID, date, intended action and exact message. Use safe screenshots without session cookies/passwords/recovery codes.
checks: My Pay, Finance, Billing, supplier team and another Worker’s time returned 403. Unrelated report/receipt returned 404 after the own-output route fix.
recovery: Do not use another account to work around denial or publish private receipt links. Marking/reading a notification, where offered, is not approval or acceptance.

chapters.title: Complete the technician handoff
chapters.context: Isolated BBS supplier role lab · genuine External Technician account · fictional October 2026 records
paragraphs: Use this task checklist for genuine authorized work in your own account. Saved, submitted, approved, financially reviewed and paid are separate states.
steps: Verify own account/environment/project/date authorization.
Record actual hours once; inspect and submit. Read returned reasons and use linked corrections.
Record each purchase once with actual payer/currency/private evidence; submit for operational review.
Save and submit required Daily/Technical facts; hand risks/open work to PM.
Check review states and current own operational totals; download permitted output only when Ready.
Give reviewer/coordinator source IDs and unresolved issues; never claim customer acceptance/pay from operational approval.
checks: Verified: own time 1→0.75 linked correction approved; coordinator 2 h separately visible; own expense 8 USD with receipt approved; own Daily/Technical submitted+approved; own Daily Ready PDF download; own operational CSV; own preview/receipt positive and unrelated/private financial denial; phone/tablet fit.
recovery: Reference-only: onboarding/reset, weekly table/layout copy/bulk mutations, report attachments, profile/security changes, browser print PDF completion, customer acceptance, real bank/email delivery.
